compare.title: Compare Versions
compare.intro: The result is the original with the differences as tracked changes. It opens in a new tab with the Changes pane.

compare.noDifferences: No differences found in the body text.
compare.failed: The versions could not be compared:

diagnostics.invalidDocx: One of the files is not a valid Word document.
diagnostics.existingRevisions: A document already contains tracked changes. Check ‘Accept existing changes first’, or accept or reject them first.
diagnostics.paragraphInsertion: Paragraphs were added. The engine currently only compares text within paragraphs that occur in both versions.
diagnostics.paragraphDeletion: Paragraphs were deleted. The engine currently only compares text within paragraphs that occur in both versions.
diagnostics.paragraphMove: Paragraphs were moved; the comparison cannot show that yet.
diagnostics.ambiguousAlignment: It is not clear which paragraphs belong together.
diagnostics.tableChange: Tables differ; the comparison cannot show table changes yet.
diagnostics.structureChange: The document structure differs (sections, tables or blocks).
diagnostics.fieldChange: Fields differ; these are not shown as changes.
diagnostics.objectChange: Images or objects differ; these are not shown as changes.
diagnostics.formattingChange: The formatting differs; formatting changes are not shown as changes.
diagnostics.unsupportedContent: The document contains content the comparison does not support.
diagnostics.unsupportedFormatting: The document contains formatting the comparison does not support.
diagnostics.outOfScopeChange: There are differences outside the body text (headers, footers, notes); these are not compared.
diagnostics.opaquePartChange: Other parts of the package differ; these are not compared.
diagnostics.metadataDifference: Document properties differ; these are not compared.
diagnostics.limitExceeded: The document is too large or too different for the comparison.
diagnostics.diagnosticsTruncated: There are more messages than shown.
diagnostics.batchRefused: The differences could not be recorded as changes.
diagnostics.serializationFailed: The result could not be saved.
diagnostics.roundtripMismatch: The result did not match the revised version.
